output.situation: The Emergency & Crisis Authority has been notified of an issue with emergency calls from Downtown due to a network problem caused by the ML energy-saving model v2.3 putting cells to sleep during peak crowds.

applicable_rules.quote: Mandate M-A3-CD-COORDINATION — agent A3 (Emergency & crisis authority, modelled on NCEMA (incl. its Civil Defence Authority)). Coordinate the services needed to address potential risks (civil defence). Permitted action types: activate_crisis_coordination, share_information.
applicable_rules.why: The Emergency & Crisis Authority is responsible for coordinating services and sharing information related to addressing potential risks.

applicable_rules.quote: Mandate M-A3-PUBLIC-ALERT — agent A3 (Emergency & crisis authority, modelled on NCEMA (incl. its Civil Defence Authority)). Operate the public alert system.
applicable_rules.why: The Emergency & Crisis Authority is responsible for operating the public alert system to warn residents of potential risks.

applicable_rules.quote: Mandate M-A3-INFORMATION — agent A3 (Emergency & crisis authority, modelled on NCEMA (incl. its Civil Defence Authority)). Obtain information from the competent and concerned authorities.
applicable_rules.why: The Emergency & Crisis Authority is responsible for obtaining information related to civil defence work and measures.

applicable_rules.quote: Channel CH-A3-A4-COORD: A3 → A4 (CDA → competent/concerned authorities (coordination)).
applicable_rules.why: The Emergency & Crisis Authority is responsible for coordinating with the Health & Ambulance Authority regarding potential risks.

output.why: Given the situation, the Emergency & Crisis Authority needs to coordinate services and share information about the root cause of the issue. They also need to inform the Health & Ambulance Authority.

messages.content: Notify A3 (Emergency & Crisis Authority) about: Root cause: ML energy-saving model v2.3 puts cells to sleep at crowd peak.

questions_to_adviser: Should we also consider activating the public alert system to inform residents of potential risks?
